description: This React component defines a page for editing or creating blog posts, with features such as live updates, auto-saving, publishing, deleting, and image uploads. It manages local state and interacts with backend via hooks and mutations.

methods.name: EditorPage
methods.description: Main React functional component for the post editor page, handling post creation, editing, auto-saving, publishing, deleting, and UI interactions.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback
methods.description: Custom hook for creating a debounced callback, delaying invocation to optimize auto-save trigger frequency.

methods.name: ensurePostId
methods.description: Ensures the post has an ID by creating a new post if necessary, used before saving or publishing actions.

methods.name: handleUploadImage
methods.description: Handles image upload, returning a URL via an upload utility.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Updates local content state and triggers debounce auto-save when the editor content changes.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Updates title state and triggers debounce auto-save when the post title changes.

methods.name: handleManualSave
methods.description: Manually triggers save of current post content and title.

methods.name: handleTogglePublish
methods.description: Toggles post publication status by publishing or unpublishing.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current post and navigates away.
